expected: The member reaches their own member-guarded content; requireActiveMember decides, since it is the stronger guard (verifies JWT + active status + billing parity).
actual: The /api/research gateway wall answers FIRST with 401 {ok:false,message:'Access required.'} and requireActiveMember never runs. 28 member-guarded routes are unreachable. The Xenios30 page repaired in PR #193 renders its failure state for exactly this member. USER-FACING BLAST RADIUS (verified by hand, 2026-07-31T08:25Z): 8 member pages cannot load for this member: Assessment.tsx (agreements, assessment), Blueprint.tsx (blueprint), Documents.tsx (documents), PrivacyControls.tsx (agreements), Xenios30.tsx (plans), Xenios90.tsx (plans), Questions.tsx (questions, telegram via adapters/guides.ts guidesPaths), Tracker.tsx (tracker via adapters/tracker.ts). PARTIAL FIX VERIFIED at e6a64b9 (PR #195): /plans/xenios30 read and the acknowledge write now pass the wall; 24 routes and 6 pages remain walled (documents, media, questions, tracker, assessment, blueprint, agreements, telegram, PUT /profile). DOCUMENTS FULLY CLOSED 4/4 at 198cf13 (verified: signed download passes, bare and malformed-sig still walled). Remaining: 20 routes across 5 pages (assessment, blueprint, media, questions, telegram, tracker, agreements) plus the PUT/DELETE verb gap.
evidence: Wall-vs-guard discriminator on production, no credentials needed. WALLED (wall answered): GET /api/research/{tracker,questions,media,telegram,documents,blueprint,assessment,plans/xenios30,plans/xenios90} all return 'Access required.'. CONTROLS (guard answered, bypass working): GET /api/research/{member/products,profile,capabilities} return 'Sign in required.'. Root cause in server/research/index.ts: the wall is satisfied only by isAuthed() = the xr_access cookie, which is minted at exactly ONE call site (setSessionCookie at :237, the shared review-password endpoint). The two bypasses do not cover these paths: DOWNSTREAM_MEMBER_GUARDED_READ_PATHS = {/capabilities,/profile,/profile/sensitive} (GET/HEAD only) and MEMBER_AUTHED_PREFIXES = [/member,/activation,/catalog,/orders] (bearer required). Every one of the 28 routes is already correctly guarded with requireActiveMember, so this fails CLOSED: it is a functional lockout, not a data exposure.
acceptance_test: A test asserting that for every route registered with requireActiveMember, a request carrying a valid member bearer token and NO xr_access cookie is not answered by the gateway wall. Anti-vacuity: the test must fail if a route is removed from the bypass sets.
